risk_factors.regulatory_risk: Subject to Sri Lankan regulatory and tax changes.

future_outlook.chairman_ceo_outlook: Management remains confident in medium- to long-term prospects despite short-term macroeconomic challenges.
future_outlook.expansion_plans: Continued investments in property, retail and logistics infrastructure.
future_outlook.expected_challenges: Macroeconomic instability, foreign exchange shortages, inflationary pressures.
future_outlook.strategy: Focus on resilience, liquidity management, digitisation and portfolio optimisation.
future_outlook.forward_looking_statements: Outlook subject to global and domestic economic conditions.

investor_friendly_insight.summary: For FY 2021/22, John Keells Holdings PLC recorded a strong rebound in profitability, with revenue of LKR 218.1 billion and profit after tax of LKR 20.4 billion, reflecting recovery across most business segments after COVID-19 disruptions.
key_strengths: Diversified business portfolio across multiple sectors
Strong recovery in EBITDA and profitability
Significant cash and liquid investments providing liquidity buffer
key_concerns: High exposure to foreign currency debt amid exchange rate volatility
Macroeconomic and inflationary pressures in Sri Lanka
Rising finance costs and leverage levels
investor_friendly_insight.risk_level_explanation: The Group faces moderate to elevated risk due to macroeconomic volatility and foreign exchange exposure, but diversification and liquidity provide some risk mitigation.
investor_friendly_insight.non_advisory_note: This is an informational summary only and not financial advice.
